description: Container image updates for stack/ (docs/stack-design.md, section 8). GitHub Actions and the pip check tools are Dependabot's (.github/dependabot.yml).
config:best-practices pins every image as tag@sha256:digest (docker:pinDigests) and keeps tag and digest current together.
A release must be 7 days old before it is proposed, the same cooldown Dependabot uses.

packageRules.description: llama.cpp server images are tagged server-cuda-b<build>: compare the build number, never switch to another variant (cpu, vulkan, rocm).
llama-swap images are tagged v<release>-cuda-b<llama.cpp build>: compare release, then build, within the cuda variant.

description: CUDA <= 13.0: the NVIDIA driver of TrueNAS SCALE 25.10 supports CUDA up to 13.0 (docs/research/e-truenas.md), so an image built for a newer CUDA would not start on the GPU.

Tags that name their CUDA version (cuda13.1, cuda-13.2, cu131, 13.1.0-...-cudnn) above 13.0 are never proposed; images whose tags do not name it are checked by hand in the update PR (the image's release notes).

packageRules.description: Major versions of databases need a dump and restore: proposed separately, never grouped or automerged.
